title: App shell
summary: The frame shared by the patient and provider apps: a collapsible sidebar and the content area beside it. Use it once, at the root of an app.

demos.title: Sidebar and content
demos.note: One frame for both apps: a collapsible sidebar with a header, sections and a footer, then the page. Shown at compact density, as the provider app uses it. The sidebar is hidden at phone width; apps show navigation in a Sheet there.

c.name: The rail keeps every destination one cli
c.text: The rail keeps every destination one click away and leaves the width to the content. Hover an icon for its name, or press the button at the top of the rail to expand it.
